about_the_game:
Blobbert 64 is a 3D platformer set in the world of Blobbert's Bouncy Breakout. Progress through a variety of worlds meeting colourful characters in order to stop the evil Araka Monoi from progressing with his plans of destroying the world! You play as Blobbert Blunger Monoi, a lab experiment made by Araka Monoi and the scientists he keeps captive. Your goal is to escape Monoi Laboratories and find the person who saved you.

You'll progress through many worlds throughout this game and maybe even new realities with your pal: Tutorialbert! He'll occasionally help you through the world and may even tag along at certain points.

Blobbert has his traditional Hammer Swing Attack, Hammer Throw Attack and Hammer Slam Jump move, although there's a little bit of content for his friends too! One of them even plays through his full campaign

So what are you waiting for? Hop into Blobbert's world and help him stop the evil Araka Monoi and save the world!!

...

Blobbert 64 is a cancelled 3D platformer recovered from an old drive. It only had the first few and last levels of the game present, although there's some other random content on the drive we threw in. Just development documents and stuff. Be careful though, the emulator is unstable and tends to break. Despite the unfinished state the game is in, we hope you can enjoy it!

content_descriptors.notes: Blobbert 64 contains light themes of death and insanity in the background. It also depicts the abuse of virtual intelligences. It also has very unrealistic blood and meat with disturbing noises when walking on it.
